title: Center Stage Theater

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Center Stage Atlanta features three separate live performance stages and venues, ranging in size, each distinctly unique. Whether live for an audience or recorded for global broadcast, the rich history and intimacy of the theater create one-in-a-lifetime performances for artists and fans. Venue use includes full concert production services with managed outsourcing for backline, streaming, video production and special fx. Our venue staff practice enhanced measures of health safety, in-house production staff are versed in the nuances of the film industry and our infrastructure offers significant support and technical resources not common in rental facilities.
